verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own docs say it supports Rule 701 compliance and Form 3921 filing, and both are listed as Premium plan features. That is direct but thin support for two of the three named compliance items. Nothing covers 83(b) elections, and nothing shows that thresholds are tracked or filings generated automatically from cap table data. missing for 10: 83(b) election support, documented automatic Rule 701 threshold tracking/alerts, documented automatic Form 3921 generation from cap table data, depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the filing workflow.

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically

citations.quote: Eqvista supports ASC 718 reporting, Rule 701 compliance, and Form 3921 filing as companies scale their equity programs.
